old_row.rationale: Both reports describe attackers carrying off livestock, killing servants with swords and leaving one messenger to report. This edition calls the first attackers raiders and the later attackers horsemen, without giving them the ethnic names found in some editions.

new_row.rationale: Both reports describe attackers carrying off livestock, killing servants with swords and leaving one messenger to report. This edition calls the first attackers raiders and the later attackers horsemen, without identifying them as the same attacking group.

changes.reason: Remove an unnecessary claim about other editions; keep the distinction grounded entirely in the two supplied passages.
